findings.title: Locked-p100 fold and station metadata are positionally rebound after a different key sort

evidence.mechanism: align_on_utc_ns sorts merged keys by layer then UTC-ns, while verified is sorted by time then layer; merged fold/station arrays are assigned to verified by position rather than key.

findings.impact: The three locked folds can contain the wrong time-layer keys, source windows and slice partitions, invalidating p100 metrics and every p100 decision gate.
findings.required_fix: Construct the verified p100 frame directly from a one-to-one key merge, or join fold/station through an indexed (UTC-ns, layer) mapping; assert zero key-to-fold/station mismatches after arbitrary input permutation and add a 78,156-row adversarial regression test.

findings.title: Windows success publication deterministically fails on read-only descriptor fsync
findings.impact: After consuming the single attempt and all numerical work, publication cannot reach a terminal success on the supported host.
findings.required_fix: Use a Windows-supported durable file-handle strategy (or rely on the already-fsynced same inode and durably flush only link metadata), then exercise the real non-mocked Windows success publication path through terminal commit.

findings.title: External authorization accepts an unverified or nonexistent independent-QA receipt

evidence.probe: An in-memory AUTHORIZED_AFTER_INDEPENDENT_QA object with report_path reports/definitely_absent_qa.json and report_sha256 deadbeef was accepted.

findings.impact: The claimed independent trust boundary is only a nonempty string assertion, not a pinned and parsed proof.
findings.required_fix: Require an exact QA-receipt schema; verify safe report path, bytes and SHA-256; parse PASS/GO plus experiment/design/seal/bundle lineage; include the receipt pin in the external authorization bundle.

findings.title: The preexecution seal is not transitively complete
findings.impact: Authorized execution imports mutable project code outside the seal, and the frozen trigger evidence is asserted but not reverified by the runner.
findings.required_fix: Either import the sealed numerical file without executing package __init__, or pin and verify every transitive project module. Add base-v1 and predecessor evidence pins plus semantic terminal checks to the seal and runtime preflight.

findings.title: Pre-exact readiness resolves the p100 path before the exact gate while reporting zero filesystem accesses
findings.impact: The implementation cannot substantiate its strict deferred-access counter on Windows, where real-path resolution may query filesystem metadata.
findings.required_fix: Do not resolve or validate the p100 path before durable exact GO; carry only literal sealed pin metadata and perform safe resolution inside the one-shot lazy loader. Add a Path.resolve/stat/open/hash spy test.

findings.title: Fallible durability and verification I/O remains after the terminal-success link

evidence.fault_probe: A directory-fsync fault immediately after terminal link left terminal_success.json present, no OOB failure, logical_state SUCCESS, but propagated OSError/nonzero execution.

findings.impact: Process outcome and artifact outcome diverge, while terminal-link durability is not proven; downstream single-attempt interpretation can be ambiguous.
findings.required_fix: Define one recoverable commit boundary, complete all possible verification before it, and make post-commit handling non-failing and explicitly recoverable. Add exact post-terminal fsync/hash/terminal-state fault tests.

findings.title: The design uses query_start for both prediction-day boundary and trajectory-start concepts

evidence.code_and_seal_behavior: source_end <= beginning-of-trajectory minus seven full days
evidence.design_query_unit_wording: query_start is D 00:00 KST, while the trajectory is [query_start-context_days, query_start)

findings.impact: The code is fail-safer and matches the seal's trajectory-start wording, but the preregistration text is needlessly ambiguous.
findings.required_fix: Rename prediction_day_start and trajectory_start explicitly without changing the frozen numeric rule.
